Chapter 6981: Heavencrush

Chapter 6981: Heavencrush

“Rumble!” The passage’s radiance blinded Survivor Realm. Tribulation Daoist and the emperors couldn’t stare straight at it either.

Nonetheless, they saw a massive figure leaping out of the passage and entering Heavenfall Path.

Fortunately, it didn’t enter Survivor Realm or its immensity would have destroyed everything.

“Boom!” Li Qiye saw it clearly - a machine with many complex parts. Immortals couldn’t understand anything upon first glance.

“Heavencrush.” Li Qiye’s curiosity was piqued.

Few in Heavenrealm have heard of it before. The fortress race had too many secrets and always kept a low profile.

“Immortal, is something big happening?” Tribulation Daoist asked.

“Yes. Many immortals will come.” Li Qiye said.

“...” They shuddered upon hearing this. Just the mere presence of immortals might be too much for their world to survive.

Everything would be reduced to ashes from the auras alone. They wouldn’t recognize death before it was too late.

“Boom!” A titanic immortal force swept through Survivor Realm, still suppressing everyone despite bearing no malice. This was an immortal entering the path in a hurry, not bothering to give their world a second glance.

“One is here.” An emperor said.

“Rumble!” More and more immortals entered the path.

One forcefully endured the tribulations to enter Ruin. They didn’t do so before due to the risk and lack of rewards.

Now, the celestial source was tempting enough, not to mention the availability of the connected path.

“Immortal, please show mercy and save the inhabitants of Survivor Realm, they are helpless.” Tribulation Daoist saw Li Qiye leaving and knelt. The emperors did the same.

As more immortals arrived, one might accidentally destroy their world. They knew Li Qiye was their only hope.

“Immortal, save us all and we will be your servants for generations.” They beseeched.

Li Qiye stared at them and sighed: “The primordial tree has appeared in Ruin, it’s not that easy to destroy this world. I will help you fortify it.”

“Thank you, Immortal.” They kowtowed repeatedly.

“Buzz.” Li Qiye waved and a figure of a primordial tree appeared deep within Heaven Pit. Its light then surrounded Survivor Realm, turning into runes under Li Qiye’s command. They eventually gathered to form a primordial chapter, protecting Survivor Realm. It became fortified and unbreakable even from attacks by immortals.

“The fate of this world is in the hands of its inhabitants. Take care.” Li Qiye said before leaving.

“Thank you, Immortal, we will worship you for eternity!” Tribulation Daoist and the others kowtowed until he disappeared.
